cause_quote: The introducing diff added `value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));`, which replaces malformed UTF-8 with replacement characters before JSON parsing.
user_saw: An interrupted Matrix send could replay a message containing replacement characters if its saved delivery plan had malformed UTF-8.
summary: The fix makes Matrix reject malformed UTF-8 in persisted delivery plans before parsing their JSON.
reasoning: The path history and introducing diff show that the same commit added persisted Matrix delivery-plan recovery and the permissive decoder, then used the decoded event content for replay. The fix PR reproduced acceptance of a malformed plan whose message body contained a replacement character, matching the behavior of the original decoder.
